top_10_general_ai.text: The Mermaid Mask review – the funniest underwater murder mystery you can play PC, Nintendo Switch/Switch 2, PS5; SFB Games Detective Grimoire is at it again in the long-awaited new entry to this stylish series of comedy whodunnits In a boom time for mystery games, the Detective Grimoire series stands out for its style and sense of humour. The Mermaid Mask continues to build upon the formula laid down in Secret of the Swamp and polished in Tangle Tower, and while there is still room for further improvements this sequel is worth the seven years’ wait. This time, the casually competent Grimoire and his smart if sarcastic sidekick Sally have been summoned to a submarine to solve the locked-room murder of its captain, Magnus Mortuga. You click around the cluttered rooms of the vessel to hear the detectives’ comedic commentary and look for clues and – closer up – click and drag to move objects around for further examination or to solve a puzzle. A year ago it was still all about chat - ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini - with o3, Claude 4 Opus, and Gemini 2.5 Pro as the models and Deep Research as a useful alternative mode. Today it's much more about agentic systems - "where the AI is capable of doing the equivalent of many hours of real human work in one go". Gemini has fallen off Ethan's list, since Google still doesn’t have an established entry in the Codex/ChatGPT Work/Cowork category. Gemini Spark has yet to prove itself! top_100_news_candidates.text: Rescale Interlink: Open-Source Data Transfer and Job Management Move simulation data between your desktop and the cloud faster with Rescale Interlink, an open-source hybrid CLI and GUI tool for managing files and jobs on Rescale. FIPS 140-3 compliant and available on Windows, Mac, and Linux, Interlink delivers multithreaded parallel transfers, a visual file browser, auto-download of completed job results, and full job submission, all in one lightweight, community-driven application.

top_100_news_candidates.title: GeoTransolver AI Model Architecture Integration for CFD Applications
top_100_news_candidates.text: GeoTransolver AI Model Architecture Integration for CFD Applications Power complex and high-accuracy AI surrogate models for CFD and FEA with GeoTransolver model architecture. Now available in Rescale AI Physics as part of the NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo library, GeoTransolver is a geometry-aware transformer architecture that uses GALE attention to model relationships across complex 3D geometries and unstructured meshes. It is designed to generalize across changing operating conditions and learn transient, geometry-aware physical behavior, making it well-suited for surrogate models that need to predict aerodynamic, structural, or deformation behavior across a range of design variants.
